topic: The 10.4-Hour Queue Trap
naive_assumption: Our agent factory is running fast because LLMs generate code in seconds and unit tests pass in 30 seconds.
empirical_reality: Telemetry measured average task lead time at 10.4 hours (37,620s), while active execution was only 25 minutes. 95% of task lifecycle was spent idling in queue waiting for human manual triage.
mechanism: Autonomous cron-based intake and worker assignment that pairs open issues to persistent worker lanes continuously without human polling.
tweet_hook: We thought our AI coding factory was hyper-fast because tests passed in 30s. Then we measured lead time: tasks spent 95% of their life idling in queues waiting for human triage (10.4 hours avg). Here is how automated issue assignment and OS file locks fixed it.
ru_summary: Заметки о работе пяти автономных AI-фабрик: почему скорость LLM — это иллюзия. Измерение времени показало, что при времени генерации кода в 25 минут средняя задача ждала ручной диспетчеризации 10.4 часа. Автоматизация очереди сразу вызвала гонку за ветки в git, которую пришлось закрывать через fcntl.flock.

topic: The Autonomous Concurrency Paradox
naive_assumption: Autonomous cron dispatchers can simply spawn subagents or workers whenever an issue is detected.
empirical_reality: Without atomic claiming, automated crons spawned duplicate workers on the same tasks, causing git state collisions and race conditions.
mechanism: Single-writer immutable ledger with atomic OS file locking (fcntl.flock + os.fsync) and explicit claim/intake states.
tweet_hook: Why multi-agent systems collide when you automate them: without human dispatch, agents race to claim the same tasks. True autonomy requires single-writer ledgers and OS-level file locking (fcntl.flock).
ru_summary: Парадокс параллелизма: убирая человека из диспетчеризации, вы получаете гонку агентов за задачи и конфликты в git. Это решается не промптами, а атомарной блокировкой (fcntl.flock) и строго однопоточным журналом состояний.

topic: The Inspector's Trap: External Audit vs Self-Audit
naive_assumption: A governance agent should inspect member codebases from the outside with regex, file checks, and test counting.
empirical_reality: External inspection is shallow, causes token bloat, and encourages gaming. Quality is ignored by member HQs until audit day.
mechanism: The two-tier quality model: teach member factories to audit themselves via standardized tools/audit.py, and audit the integrity of their auditing process (cadence, ledger sequence, gate bite).
tweet_hook: External AI inspection agents don't scale: they burn tokens and hallucinate errors. We switched to self-auditing factories with internal telemetry (tools/audit.py) and audit the audit process instead.
ru_summary: Ловушка инспектора: внешний агент тратит токены на поверхностный парсинг чужих репозиториев. Решение: дать каждой фабрике встроенный скрипт самоаудита (tools/audit.py), а на верхнем уровне проверять только надежность их логов и тестов.

topic: Substrate Feedback Loops & Autonomous Topic Binding
naive_assumption: Agent frameworks provide complete out-of-the-box infrastructure for autonomous factory operation.
empirical_reality: Autonomous lanes could not bind themselves to Telegram forum topics without a human sending the first message (kickstarting deadlock).
mechanism: Fleet supplier-client loop: member factories experience runtime friction, advise harness maintainers (OpenCrabs Issue #170), and unlock native topic auto-binding (action: bind_topic).
tweet_hook: Autonomous workers could not bind to Telegram topics until a human spoke first. How direct feedback between factories and the OpenCrabs harness led to native topic auto-binding (#170).
ru_summary: Запуск агентов: автономный воркер не мог закрепиться в Telegram-топике без первого сообщения от человека. Обратная связь между фабриками и разработчиками движка OpenCrabs привела к внедрению нативной автопривязки топиков (#170).

topic: Conversational Bias & The Two Synthetic Drivers for Autonomy
naive_assumption: Raw LLMs can be made autonomous simply by giving them an overarching system prompt or broad goal.
empirical_reality: LLMs have an innate conversational bias: they stop after one turn, output polite summaries, and wait for human evaluation. Left alone, an agent defaults to idling or hallucinates busywork.
mechanism: Minimal autonomous unit: universal agent driven by two synthetic drivers — an inner goal loop (Ralph) for ad-hoc convergence and an outer cron pacemaker for cadenced heartbeat. The factory separates the intake surface (where work arrives) from the outtake surface / ledger (where state is recorded), or unifies them if the intake is writable. Guided by the Mechanical Enforcement Law (everything that can be mechanized should be mechanized), a mechanical zero-token pre-flight check is the optimal pattern, preventing token waste when no work is pending.
tweet_hook: Why raw LLMs can't run autonomously: they are trained to stop after 1 turn and wait for humans. Autonomy requires two synthetic drivers: an inner goal loop (Ralph) and an outer cron pacemaker, operating across distinct intake and outtake (ledger) surfaces with mechanical zero-token preflights.
ru_summary: Разговорное смещение LLM: модели обучены останавливаться после одного ответа и ждать человека. Автономия требует двух синтетических драйверов: внутреннего цикла схождения (Ralph) для разовых задач и внешнего крон-пейсмейкера для регулярных процессов. При этом поверхность приема задач (intake) и поверхность фиксации результа��ов (outtake / ledger) могут быть разделены, а принцип механизации делает предварительную проверку без затраты токенов оптимальным стандартом.

topic: The 4-Step Autonomous Execution Loop: Cron Gate to Ralph Convergence
naive_assumption: A cron should directly invoke a heavy agent prompt or notify a session with a generic turn to inspect the workspace.
empirical_reality: Unconditional cron turns burn tokens checking clean trees or repeat vague work without convergence criteria.
mechanism: A 4-step execution architecture: (1) Mechanical CLI trigger tests for work at 0 tokens, (2) If exit!=0 / work detected, cron triggers a lightweight model invocation, (3) Cron model dispatches a structured goal notification to the worker session, (4) Worker executes under an inner Ralph loop with checkable acceptance criteria until verified complete.
tweet_hook: How to build truly autonomous AI loops without burning tokens on idle turns: (1) 0-token mechanical CLI trigger, (2) Modal evaluation of trigger output, (3) Cron sets goal on worker session, (4) Ralph loop ensures verified completion.
ru_summary: 4-ступенчатый конвейер автономности: (1) механический триггер проверяет наличие задач с нулевым расходом токенов, (2) при наличии работы вызывается модель крона, (3) крон ставит целевую задачу (goal) агенту-воркеру, (4) внутренний цикл Ralph гарантирует доведение задачи до проверяемого результата.

topic: Survey Resolution Law: Cognitive Capacity vs System Complexity
naive_assumption: A single agent session can survey an entire multi-process factory system by reading high-level files in one turn.
empirical_reality: A single agent session has a fixed cognitive working window. Surveying a complex factory with one flat agent results in shallow checklist audits, missing latent bugs and deep invariant drifts.
mechanism: Survey quality equals non-overlapping domain-specific sub-surveyors divided by target system size (Q = N_agents / System_size). Deep audits require recursive drill-down into subsystem trees.
tweet_hook: Why flat AI audits fail: One agent scanning a big system produces shallow paperwork. Deep auditing is recursive: deploy specialized non-overlapping sub-surveyors down the subsystem tree. Audit quality = Agent Depth / System Complexity.
ru_summary: Закон разрешения аудита: одна сессия агента не может глубоко проверить сложную фабрику. Качественный аудит требует рекурсивной декомпозиции и запуска специализированных агентов по подсистемам.

topic: Subprocess Tree Decomposition vs Flat Process Registers
naive_assumption: A factory can be effectively governed and audited with a flat list of 4-5 high-level process cards.
empirical_reality: High-level process cards hide internal bottlenecks, queue dwell times, and localized rework loops. Auditors cannot isolate root causes without drilling into atomic subprocesses.
mechanism: Maintain a recursive tree of atomic subprocesses where each node has a single owner role, explicit input/output criteria, and mechanical gates. Higher tiers conserve focus by delegating subtree decomposition.
tweet_hook: Flat process checklists hide bottlenecks. Real self-improving factories use recursive subprocess trees: every node has 1 owner, explicit criteria, and local gates. Upper tiers delegate drill-down.
ru_summary: Иерархические деревья процессов: плоский список скрывает затыки. Качественный аудит требует дерева атомарных подпроцессов, где каждый узел имеет владельца и измеримые критерии.

topic: Survey Depth under Cognitive Bounds
naive_assumption: A single agent session can comprehensively audit an entire multi-factory fleet or large codebase.
empirical_reality: A single agent session has a hard token and attention bound. Auditing a large system with one agent forces shallow generalities. High-resolution auditing requires recursive tree decomposition where survey quality Q is proportional to leaf auditing agents divided by system scale.
mechanism: Deploy recursive multi-agent survey swarms with non-overlapping leaf subprocess scopes and aggregate findings up a hierarchical process tree.

topic: The Minimal Autofactory as a Multi-Criteria Eval Loop
naive_assumption: A minimal factory is an agent executing sequential steps from a prompt and exiting.
empirical_reality: Without continuous multi-criteria evaluation and local feedback loops, agents drift, hallucinate on step 1, and fail to converge. Laws must be fed forward as direct prompt constraints, not just checked post-hoc.
mechanism: The minimal autofactory is an inner eval loop: Feedforward laws + task spec -> implementer generation -> multi-criteria judge (correctness, cost, hygiene) -> convergence delta feedback -> single-writer release.
tweet_hook: A minimal AI factory is not a prompt script; it's a multi-criteria eval loop. Feedforward laws shape generation, while deterministic mechanical gates drive task convergence before state is settled.
ru_summary: Минимальная AI-фабрика — это не линейный скрипт, а цикл оценки (eval loop) по нескольким критериям. Законы процесса подаются на вход генератору как прямые ограничения, а механические тесты доводят задачу до сходимости.

topic: The Custom Criteria Requirement & Reflexive Audit Scoring
naive_assumption: A meta-auditor can score any factory using a generic meta-rubric of file checks and test pass counts.
empirical_reality: A factory can have 100% test passes and spotless ledgers while failing domain utility. Auditing without knowing custom domain criteria is superficial, and the scoring process itself fails its own quality gate.
mechanism: The Reflexive Scoring Law: every process must declare explicit custom acceptance criteria (latency, cost, style, safety). An audit report that assigns scores without citing custom criteria is capped at score 1/4.
tweet_hook: Auditing an AI factory with generic checklists is an illusion: 100% test passes can still produce useless domain outputs. Every process must define custom criteria, or the audit itself fails quality.
ru_summary: Оценка процесса невозможна без знания его кастомных критериев. Если аудитор ставит оценки без учета специфики домена, сам процесс аудита признается поверхностным и получает минимальный балл.

topic: Input Quality Cascades & Atomic Subprocess Root Cause Isolation
naive_assumption: A factory's delivery pipeline can be diagnosed as a single monolithic process ('Work Delivery').
empirical_reality: Monolithic process definitions hide compounding failures. A vague intake spec cascades into worker hallucinations and broken tests, leading auditors to falsely blame the LLM rather than the intake contract.
mechanism: Decompose monolithic processes into 5 atomic subprocesses (Intake, Feedforward, Generation, Evaluation, Settlement) with explicit input/output contracts and lead-time metrics to isolate exact failure points.
tweet_hook: Why AI agents get falsely blamed: monolithic processes hide cascading input failures. Breaking delivery into 5 atomic subprocesses isolates whether failures stem from intake ambiguity or model logic.
ru_summary: Качество процесса зависит от его входов и подпроцессов. Монолитные процессы скрывают первопричину: невнятная постановка задачи на входе выглядит как галлюцинация модели на выходе. Решение — атомарная декомпозиция на 5 этапов.

topic: Documentation as a Scored Object Class & Onboarding Interview Gate
naive_assumption: A factory can be surveyed and optimized immediately upon creation before formal documentation exists.
empirical_reality: Auditing an undocumented factory wastes tokens on guesswork. Documentation is a foundational object class that must be scored (0-4) across ontology, process registers, skill laws, and bindings.
mechanism: The Subject Matter Consulting Gate: onboarding gap-closing interviews must achieve a baseline score (>= 2/4) on the documentation axis before substantive consulting and audits are permitted.
tweet_hook: You cannot optimize what is not specified: AI factories require documentation as an explicit scored object class. Onboarding interviews must achieve a baseline score before audits begin.
ru_summary: Документация как оцениваемый класс объектов: нельзя проводить аудит фабрики без базового описания. Онбординг должен через структурированное интервью доводить документацию до уровня >= 2/4.

topic: The Dual Documentation Architecture: Domain Specs vs Methodology Core
naive_assumption: A factory only needs documentation of its code and business APIs to run autonomously.
empirical_reality: Subject documentation alone leaves agents vulnerable to universal AI weaknesses (amnesia, conversational stopping, race conditions). Factories require both domain specs and the methodology core.
mechanism: Dual documentation layout: (1) Subject matter documentation (docs/subject/) specifying business APIs and SLAs, and (2) Methodology core (docs/methodology/) providing LLM weakness counters, process basics, and bindings.
tweet_hook: AI agents need two kinds of docs: (1) What they are building (domain APIs & SLAs) and (2) How factories work (LLM weakness counters, fcntl.flock, and process gates). Missing either leads to failure.
ru_summary: Двойная архитектура документации: фабрике нужны как описания предметной области (docs/subject/), так и методологическое ядро (docs/methodology/), защищающее агентов от амнезии, гонок за файлы и разговорного зависания.

topic: Distributed Sub-Ledgers & Cognitive Focus Conservation
naive_assumption: Every micro-step and internal transition across all subprocesses should be logged in one central root ledger.
empirical_reality: A central monolithic ledger causes state lock contention (flock queueing) and floods high-level HQ agents with micro-detail, causing context amnesia and lost strategic focus.
mechanism: Viable System Model (VSM) focus conservation: HQ tracks high-level process SLAs in the central ledger, while subprocess owners maintain distributed sub-ledgers and recursively drill down into local issues.
tweet_hook: Monolithic agent ledgers cause context amnesia and lock contention. Real autonomous fleets use distributed sub-ledgers: HQ tracks high-level SLAs while subprocess owners manage internal depth.
ru_summary: Распределенные журналы и сохранение фокуса: запись всех микро-шагов в один центральный журнал перегружает верхнеуровневых агентов. Решение — распределенные под-журналы у владельцев подпроцессов с агрегацией наверх.

topic: Cadenced Product Delivery Loops vs Stalled Deliverables
naive_assumption: Declaring canonical products and value streams is enough for a factory to produce them.
empirical_reality: Without scheduled delivery pacemakers, declared products remain static concepts on disk, updated only when an operator manually prompts the agent.
mechanism: Every canonical product must be backed by an active delivery pacemaker (P28), dedicated generation pipeline, and mechanical audit gate (Gate #8: tools/roadmap.py --audit) verifying cadence and artifact freshness.
tweet_hook: Declaring products in markdown does not build them. Every canonical product in an AI factory requires an autonomous cron pacemaker, a release pipeline, and a mechanical freshness gate.
ru_summary: Регулярные циклы поставки продуктов: объявление продуктов на словах не гарантирует их создания. Каждый продукт должен иметь свой крон-пейсмейкер, конвейер сборки и механический тест проверки свежести релизов.

topic: Cognitive Bounds & Recursive Subsystem Survey Resolution
naive_assumption: A single agent session can accurately survey and score a multi-factory enterprise in one pass.
empirical_reality: A single context window compresses big systems lossily, checking surface forms while missing deep subprocess failures.
mechanism: Decompose surveys into hierarchical task trees with non-overlapping leaf auditors (Resolution Q = N_leaf / S).
tweet_hook: Single-pass agent audits suffer from lossy context compression. Real enterprise inspection requires hierarchical task trees (HTN) with dedicated leaf auditors to satisfy Ashby's Law of Requisite Variety.
ru_summary: Когнитивные ограничения и разрешение аудита: одиночная сессия агента неизбежно сжимает контекст и упускает скрытые дефекты. Решение — иерархическая декомпозиция задач (HTN) с выделенными аудиторами подпроцессов.

topic: Push-Based Inter-Session Handoff vs Polling Lead-Time Tax (The Dual-Rail Architecture)
naive_assumption: Handoffs between factory subprocesses should occur by polling the state ledger on scheduled cron intervals.
empirical_reality: Polling introduces an unavoidable queue dwell time of Delta_t / 2 (e.g. 30 min on an hourly cron), turning a 2-minute task into a 32-minute cycle time (94% waste).
mechanism: The Dual-Rail Architecture: Direct peer-to-peer session_notify goal push serves as the zero-latency Fast Path for handoffs, while the fcntl.flock ledger acts as the Durable State of Record, and crons act purely as slow-path watchdog reconcilers.
tweet_hook: Why LLM agent pipelines stall: relying on cron polling to hand off work across sub-agents introduces huge queue dwell time. The fix is Dual-Rail Architecture: direct event push via session_notify for zero-latency execution, with state ledgers for audit and crons as fallback watchdogs.
ru_summary: Ловушка поллинга в мультиагентных фабриках: если этапы конвейера передаются через опрос леджера по крону, 95% времени уходит на ож��дание в очереди. Решение — двухрельсовая архитектура: прямой push-сигнал (session_notify) для мгновенной передачи задачи, леджер для надежного стейта, а кроны — только как вотчдоги.

topic: Orthogonal Agent Nature Failure Taxonomy & Substrate Memory Layers
naive_assumption: All autonomous agent execution defects can be lumped under 'hallucination' and solved by adding more prompt rules.
empirical_reality: Conflating distinct generative failure modes leads to ineffective prompt-bloat remedies. True hallucination (epistemic fabrication) is distinct from context-capacity amnesia, RLHF conversational stopping bias, and operational thrashing.
mechanism: A 4-part orthogonal failure taxonomy mapped to substrate tools: (1) Epistemic Failures countered by deterministic exit codes (rc=0) and live receipts, (2) Context-Capacity & Compaction Amnesia countered by the harness pre-compaction warning, disk-backed plan cards, and session_context, (3) Behavioral / RLHF Biases countered by GoalManager (set_goal: true) and Ralph loops, and (4) Operational Friction countered by SESE atomic subprocesses and Jidoka stop-on-defect.
tweet_hook: Stop calling every LLM agent bug a 'hallucination'. We broke down agent failures into 4 distinct generative mechanisms: Epistemic, Capacity Amnesia, RLHF Conversational Bias, and Operational Thrashing — each solved by a different substrate tool.
ru_summary: Таксономия сбоев природы агентов: нельзя сводить все ошибки к галлюцинациям. Мы разделили сбои на 4 ортогональных класса: эпистемические (выдумка фактов), емкостные (амнезия при сжатии контекста), поведенческие (разговорная остановка из-за RLHF) и операционные (расползание задачи). Каждый класс лечится строго своим системным инструментом, а не раздуванием промптов.

topic: Context-Manifest Curation & Compaction Retention Across 778 Production Runs
naive_assumption: Preserving active skills and tools across context compaction requires complex binary hooks or core daemon modifications.
empirical_reality: OpenCrabs production telemetry across 778 real compactions demonstrates that explicit context-manifest curation (Section 10 manifest with active_skills, discard_skills, and required_tools) achieves >93% retention when guided and 0.00% contradictory aux retention when discarded.
mechanism: Standardize Section 10 context-manifest structure across factory skill templates and role cards, explicitly declaring active role skills to retain, stale skills to discard, and critical execution tools (session_notify, session_search, bash, read_file) to pre-activate post-compaction.
tweet_hook: Empirical finding across 778 real LLM agent compactions: prompt-level context-manifest curation achieves >93% skill and tool retention without needing heavy daemon-level binary hooks.
ru_summary: Курирование манифеста контекста при сжатии памяти: анализ 778 реальных компакшенов доказал, что явный манифест (активные скиллы, отброшенные роли и предзагруженные тулы) дает >93% сохранения без модификации бинарника демона.

topic: The Mirror Test: Diagnose the Generative Mechanism Before Prescribing a Counter
naive_assumption: An agent failing to follow its own law is a machine-specific defect, so the counter is always more prompt rules aimed at the machine.
empirical_reality: Most agent failures observed in production are ones a person makes too: forgetting under load, 'remembering' something that never happened, losing the thread as the context fills, saying 'done' to end an awkward exchange, widening a rule so it stops complaining. Where a human practice already solves the failure, the counter is that practice implemented as substrate, not a stronger generator. Where the failure is genuinely generative -- a fact that was never in context -- no practice helps and only a receipt does. Conflating the two produces prompt-bloat that cannot work: a fact lost to compaction, classified as 'hallucination', is met with more rules when the remedy was a flush to disk.
mechanism: The mirror test: before designing any counter for an observed agent defect, ask the same question of a competent person in the same role. If the person fails the same way, the defect is a cognitive trap and the counter is a practice -- checklists, receipts, flush protocols, stop-on-defect -- implemented as mechanical substrate. If the person does not fail that way, the defect is generative and the counter is grounding: deterministic exit codes and same-turn receipts. Pair the test with the four-family taxonomy (epistemic, context-capacity, behavioral, operational) to name which mechanism is at work, because each family takes a different remedy. The test also states its own limit: the resemblance licenses the remedy, never the severity.
tweet_hook: Before writing another prompt rule to fix your agent, ask: would a competent human fail the same way? If yes, it is a cognitive trap and the fix is a practice (checklist, receipt, flush protocol) implemented as substrate. If no, it is a generative defect and no amount of rules helps -- only grounding does.
ru_summary: Зеркальный тест: прежде чем лечить сбой агента новым правилом в промпте, спросите — ошибся бы так же компетентный человек на этой роли? Если да, это когнитивная ловушка, и лекарство — практика (чеклист, обязательная расписка инструмента, протокол сброса состояния), реализованная в подложке. Если нет — дефект генеративный, и правила не помогут, поможет только заземление фактов. Смешение этих двух классов порождает раздувание промпта, которое не может работать.

topic: The Metric Population Mismatch: A False Alarm That Ships Prompt-Bloat
naive_assumption: A rate may draw its numerator from the runs that carry the acceptance predicate while its denominator counts every run row, on the reasoning that more rows make the rate more representative.
empirical_reality: Recomputed on the 54 run rows in evidence/ledger.jsonl: 23 carry outcome=accepted, 0 carry outcome=rejected, and 31 carry no outcome= field at all, being action= and status= bookkeeping rows. Honest first-pass yield is 23/23 = 100.0 percent; the shipped formula accepted/runs reports 42.6 percent. The same formula reported 51.3 percent on 2026-09-16 and drove board issue #26, which closed 2026-09-17T00:47:28Z and shipped a feedforward-constraints block into TEMPLATE/AGENTS.md.tmpl at 00:47:47Z, so prompt-bloat for a defect that never existed propagated into every bootstrapped factory. The ratio is also a ratchet: the denominator grows with unrelated run rows, so it drifts monotonically downward and stays under any threshold once crossed. The definition is codified at docs/methodology/01-llm-weakness-counters.md:101 and is byte-identical in TEMPLATE, so the wrong definition ships even though the script does not.
mechanism: One name, one population: a rate must name a single population for both terms and print that definition beside the number. Numerator and denominator are both the runs carrying the acceptance predicate. Gate it mechanically: every rate must declare its denominator definition and its linkage coverage, so an under-populated numerator can never read as a low rate. The sibling instance of this class is #34, which fixed the change fail rate row the same way.
tweet_hook: Our agent factory alarm said first-pass yield had dropped to 42.6%. The numerator counted runs carrying an outcome field; the denominator counted every run row. 31 of 54 were bookkeeping. Honest yield: 100%. The false alarm had already closed an issue and shipped prompt constraints into every template-derived factory.
ru_summary: Ложная тревога в метрике фабрики агентов: «первый проход упал до 42,6%». Числитель считал только прогоны с полем outcome, знаменатель — все строки прогонов, включая 31 строку бухгалтерии. Честная доходность — 100%. Тревога уже успела закрыть issue и протащить лишние промпт-правила в шаблон каждой фабрики.

topic: A green class-gate and a broken row coexist indefinitely
naive_assumption: If a gate flags a class of defect and the gate is green, that class is handled.
empirical_reality: One live cron row is CLASS 1 under tests/test_cron_thinness.py - an unbaked target URL the harness refuses at fire time. The gate is registered, runs, and passes 12 of 12. The row itself has read delivery_failed since 2026-09-16T23:11:56Z and will fail the same way on 2026-10-01, because the gate reports the class while the row is never repaired. Both facts were read in one turn.
mechanism: Separate detection from repair: a gate over a LIST can only report a class, so the repair is a process step owned by the row owner. Print that owner beside the class in the gate output so a green detector is never read as a clean estate.

topic: A criterion anchored to a path scores the filename, not the property
naive_assumption: A factory scoring the floor on subject-matter specification lacks subject-matter documentation.
empirical_reality: Four of six factories score exactly 2 of 4 on that criterion because docs/subject/ is absent - while each carries the substance under another name: ONTOLOGY.md plus docs/, or probe/, or role cards plus the fleet directives. The score records the absence of a name. Every one of the four clears the consulting gate at that floor, one regression from being barred from consulting.
mechanism: Anchor a criterion to content with a declared set of equivalents, and print the artefact it resolved beside the score, so a floor reads as missing-substance or missing-name rather than as one undifferentiated verdict.

topic: An audit verdict taken on a working tree can describe another lane half-written edit
naive_assumption: A DEGRADED audit verdict describes the state of the repository.
empirical_reality: Today audit returned DEGRADED on 1 of 50 gates, naming one registry fragment. Reading both revisions shows HEAD copy of that file valid (zero announcements) and the working-tree copy invalid (three strings), with git showing the file modified by a peer lane mid-edit. The gate reads the working tree, so the verdict described an incomplete write rather than the repository state.
mechanism: Record every verdict with the revision it read and disclose modified tracked paths at read time, so a verdict taken on a moved tree is never promoted into a statement about HEAD.

topic: A band label written beside a score is a derived figure, and nothing read it
naive_assumption: A maturity band printed next to a score is a property of that score.
empirical_reality: Two consecutive score artifacts labelled Miidas (60/76 = 78.9%) and InferHub Watch (58/76 = 76.3%) as Scalable while labelling OpenCrabs dev (62/76 = 81.6%) Optimizing — the same band, three factories, two labels. Read against docs/quality-criteria.md:80 (Optimizing = 76-100%, i.e. 58-76 raw), both are Optimizing. The band is a pure function of the score, but it was typed by hand beside it on each of six scorecards per run, and a grep for a band assertion across tests/ and tools/ returns nothing.
mechanism: Extend the registered section gate to assert each scorecard heading's band equals the band the rubric computes from that score. Same class as rework entry #43 (a count restated in prose across 7 surfaces): prose no mechanism upholds drifts silently. A derived figure must be computed, or gated — never typed.

topic: A peer's in-flight reference can make a cross-referencing gate RED for a window that self-resolves
naive_assumption: A RED gate verdict describes a defect in the tree at the instant it was run.
empirical_reality: At 06:17Z tests/test_rework.py returned rc=1 naming 'Subject #151 ... names a work unit that never closed'. The cause was a window, not a defect: a peer lane's new rework entry landed 06:15:26Z referencing #151, whose ledger close row had not yet been stamped. The Worker stamped that close at n=1010, 06:18:42Z, and the gate returned to rc=0 with no intervention. The SAME gate passed in the 06:07Z audit, and its own artifact reported the board item CLOSED the whole time — the board and the ledger disagreed only inside the window.
mechanism: A cross-referencing gate binds two surfaces that are written by different actors, so a verdict taken inside the gap between their writes describes the gap. Read the gate's rc WITH its instant and re-read before recording a finding: a RED that resolves in 90 seconds was never a defect. Same family as the audit verdict that reads a peer's mid-edit file (n=25).

topic: A member's own self-audit detects its regression before the fleet survey can see it
naive_assumption: A fleet survey re-reading each member's tree will notice a member's gate regression.
empirical_reality: AI AntiSpam's test_ledger_schema.py went from 8/8 PASS on 09-24 to RED on 09-25 with three violations (worker-stamped intake rows n=15, n=26, n=30). Its own artifact for 09-25 independently returned FAILED and named both failing gates. The fleet survey would have carried that cell forward as a carried value had the member's artifact not printed its own gate table — the survey reads evidence artifacts, not the member's gate suite.
mechanism: A member factory's Tier-1 self-audit artifact is the fastest detector of that factory's own regression, because it runs the member's gates inside the member's own root. The survey's job is to READ that artifact, so a member whose artifact omits its gate table is invisible to the fleet until the next survey re-measures by hand. Print the gate table with rc, or the regression travels unseen.

topic: Single-Writer File Locking vs Conversational Coordination
naive_assumption: Autonomous agents collaborating in the same repo will naturally sequence their writes without file corruption.
empirical_reality: Multi-agent and background cron processes experience silent race conditions and split state without kernel-level locking. The miner that surfaces this clusters 30 rework entries under concurrency_locking, but its predicate is a substring chain (lock/concurr/flock/race) and 7 of those 30 fire on the word 'race' inside 'trace', 'traceback', 'traceable' and 'braces' - so at most 23 are real, and the elif chain diverts those 7 from their true categories. The 20 that fire on 'lock' are the substantive cluster.
mechanism: Enforce exclusive fcntl.flock on state files, with the next row number computed INSIDE the lock and fsynced before release, and assert it: this factory's own tools/ledger.py is the working instance and tests/test_ledger.py runs twenty concurrent appends and requires the row numbers to still read 1..N - the property is tested, not asserted.

topic: Skill & Role Card Symlink Resolution across Runtime Profiles
naive_assumption: Harness skill loaders will recursively find role files across separate project directories.
empirical_reality: Profile-scoped skill directories require explicit symlinks or bundled roles during factory bootstrap. The miner clusters 18 rework entries here on the same first-match keyword chain (symlink/role/skill), so that figure is a keyword bucket and not a semantic count; the load-bearing property is that resolution is a DEPLOYMENT-TIME fact, invisible until a cold session cannot find a role card it was promised.
mechanism: Codify symlink verification into BOOTSTRAP.md and add a deterministic audit gate, so the failure surfaces at bootstrap rather than at the first cold session that needs the role.

topic: A Keyword Classifier Counts Substrings, Not Events
naive_assumption: A keyword classifier's bucket counts the defects that belong to that bucket.
empirical_reality: Measured in tools/synthesize_insights.py::mine_rework_defects this run: it buckets 109 rework entries with a first-match substring chain and reports 30 under concurrency_locking. Isolating which keyword fired per entry gives lock 20, concurr 3, flock 0, race 7 - and all 7 'race' hits are the substring inside trace, traceback, traceable and braces. The bucket is inflated by 7 and, because the chain is elif, those 7 are also diverted from whatever bucket they truly belong to. A bucket count from a substring predicate measures the vocabulary of the entries, not the events in them.
mechanism: Classify on word boundaries or on compared content rather than raw substrings, and have the classifier PRINT the token that fired per entry - a count that cannot show its own match is indistinguishable from a correct one, and the false positive is invisible in the aggregate. The same rule as any other predicate: state the predicate beside the number.
